name: bobbin
description: Keep the thread: durable project context with project-selected features and recording policies.

interface.shortDescription: Keep the thread across AI coding sessions.
interface.longDescription: One plugin for decisions, evidence, handoffs, assumptions, terminology, intent and living documents. Select features and explicit, automatic or adaptive recording per project. Plain Markdown; no service required.
defaultPrompt: Set up Bobbin for this project.
